html: Here’s the latest update on where I stand with contract work between Janklow & Nesbit (my literary agency) and the publishing house I’ve agreed to sign with.  The publisher sent over a contract, my agency’s attorneys reviewed it and made a few changes, now the publisher’s attorneys are reviewing those changes.  As soon as all that gets settled, then the series will be re-released (both in print and in all the eBook formats) under a new imprint.  The publisher will have one of their editors review each of the novels, then I’ll review their changes, then it’ll go to publication.  In the meantime, they have the manuscripts and I’m hard at work on my next novel.
